name: @mosaic-code/prisma-select-for-update
description: Prisma v7 extension for SELECT ... FOR UPDATE row locking

scripts.prepublishOnly: npm run clean && npm run build
scripts.db:setup: npm run db:up && sleep 2 && npm run db:push
scripts.release:patch: npm version patch && git push --follow-tags && npm run build && npm publish
scripts.release:minor: npm version minor && git push --follow-tags && npm run build && npm publish
scripts.release:major: npm version major && git push --follow-tags && npm run build && npm publish
scripts.version: conventional-changelog -p conventionalcommits -i CHANGELOG.md -s && git add CHANGELOG.md
